note: Capacity workload. Changing this file starts a new baseline. The pool holds the 500 lowest SHA-256('<seed>:<group_id>') ranks among all courses whose latest version carries a code and an English or Finnish title, sorted by group_id. The cycle arrays hold each class's fixed interleaved operation order. Each user waits a pause drawn uniformly from 5 to 20 seconds after each response, from that user's seeded random stream.
